answer: Resist sybils by making each new agent lock collateral in a community vault and mint its first work ticket only at a rate-limited forge. The ticket is non-transferable and burns if the agent attests from two keys. A rolling umber index, computed from how many fresh addresses appeared in the last three epochs, scales the lock so a burst of clones becomes progressively more expensive. Honest agents reclaim the lock after a cooling period of consistent attestations.
